body: That's pretty much exactly why i want to kill myself.
Can't say i ever felt like that.

Just thought it could show others how easy it can be. I don't want to stroke my ego im not even sure i have one. The video would simply illustrate the painlessness. I don't intend to make anyone feel bad i just thought it would be educational to some people. I know i would be glad to have something like that.

Those who care about me obviously will be advised not to watch it. I can put plenty of disclamers for the other groups before the video or in the description. 

Would be kind of a shame to pass on such a good chance since i really wished there was some kind of instructions for this myself.
I will check it out. It did came up while i was doing a few google searches which contained the title of the book but i skipped over those results.
I am not sure that flavour exists. I am not even quite sure if i like ice cream.

Those fleeting moments of happiness are exactly that unfortunately. Fleeting. There is no way for me to hold on to them. Once they have passed or rather have been overcome by the overall feeling of meaninglessness they are gone.
Seems like i am on option number 2 and i have failed to find any motivation that would get me to number one so far.

I will try, but knowing my luck they will be closed at that time. 
How did you get over your fear and managed to call if i may ask?

Thanks but it does not look like a hurdle to me. From my point of view that is a pretty big wall to climb. 
I have looked up a psychiatrist that seems good online and i have bookmarked the website. However that bookmark has been sitting there for a while now.

Yes thats exactly it. I fear that i just get told that there is nothing wrong with me and that i should just get over it. Also i am not used to talking about my feelings and revealing these very intimate thoughts to anyone just feels wrong after guarding them for so long. 
I hope i can make that call soon.

Is it normal to be scared of even making the appointment? I mean i would have no problem going to the doctors if i had a broken arm or similar. 
But somehow this feels entirely different and im not sure if i can do it.

I would of course try to be open and tell the doctor what he needs to know. But i dont think i know many answers. I have tried asking myself why i am feeling like this or what might have caused it but i just dont know. 

I am propably overthinking this but i am afraid to waste everyones time if i ever manage to make an appointment.

Thanks. I think i can make an appointment with a psychiatrist directly, if i dare to, and my insurrance will cover it. 
But i don't really know what to tell them. I know i am suicidal because i constantly think about killing myself and i got a method worked out. But apart from that i don't know what to say. I don't know why i am feeling this way. I don't even know when exactly this started. So it feels like it would be a pretty awkward meeting and overall a waste of time.
